column1: # Temple of Seasons' texts the compact text leaves as the game lays them out (engine/language/language_wrap.c), beyond
# the pages its rules keep by themselves (a choice, a secret, a call, the piece of heart, lines aligned with spaces, a
# single box). A row: the texts (the four hexadecimal digits of their TX_GGII, or a range first-last, space-separated),
# the languages (en, the fan game's English, the only one laid out), and why. Only their identifiers: the texts stay in
# the image the player makes from his ROM and the fan game's patch.

column3: a song, a verse a line, Seasons' own text
a sign, each direction an arrow and lines of its own
a word broken at a line's end by its syllables, one of whose parts the language writes alone and never the word whole: laid out, it would keep its hyphen
